answer: Bind each agent to one household smart meter: the meter signs a daily usage proof, the network checks that signature against the utility registry, and a second meter claiming the same anchor voids both identities. Removing a meter breaks its tamper seal, forcing a utility visit and a 14-day re-verification before the agent earns again. Forging 10,000 fake agents needs 10,000 real meters at $120 installation each plus $35 a month in bills, $1,550,000 in year one and 120 days of utility checks. Like a lantern that lights only its own house, an echo from the wrong meter gives the fake away.
